slides.texte_overlay:
How to be a better brother
as you get older
Call without a reason. Not only on birthdays or when something is wrong. A random call to say hi keeps the bond strong as life gets busy.
Forget old childhood fights. Who broke what, who got more. Holding on to those stories keeps you stuck at twelve years old.
Celebrate his wins out loud. New job, new home, a baby. Being genuinely proud of your brother is one of the strongest things you can do.
Be there for the hard moments. Breakups, job losses, family problems. Showing up matters more than knowing the right words.
Before: our calls were always short. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and now I always have stories to share with him.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: our calls were always short. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Now I always have stories to share with him.

slides.texte_overlay: Create new memories together. A yearly trip, a match, a weekend away. Shared adventures keep brothers close as adults.
Take care of your parents together. Share the visits, the calls, the help. Facing it as a team brings you closer.
